title: Love the Skylight Calendar? Try This Subscription-Free Alternative for $100 Off
gist: Wired's reviewer recommends the Everblog HomeCal 21.5-inch digital calendar as a subscription-free alternative to Skylight, now $300 on Amazon.

insights.claim: Skylight is the enduring favorite digital calendar but puts its photo screensaver and meal planning behind a paywall, creating an opening for subscription-free rivals.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Subscription gating in family-organizer hardware is a pricing vulnerability.

insights.claim: Everblog's 21.5-inch HomeCal offers chore tracking, rewards, to-dos, and meal planning with no subscription, and is on sale at $300 on Amazon versus $400 list.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Reference pricing and feature parity at lower total cost of ownership.
insights.locator: The Best Digital Calendar Without a Sub

insights.claim: Digital calendars aggregate Google Calendar, iCal and Outlook and double as chore trackers, photo frames and meal planners, which the reviewer finds more useful than smart displays.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Single-purpose family displays are competing with voice-assistant smart displays.
insights.locator: I test gadgets for a living

insights.claim: Almost no digital calendars offer a voice assistant, and the one that does charges for it.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Voice features are being used as a subscription upsell.
